result.instructions: Tools for CustomCat, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is the status of order 101-102938 and has it shipped?"; "List the products I set up in CustomCat and their variant SKUs."; "Is catalog SKU 39515 in stock, and what would shipping to Detroit cost?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CustomCat data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run customcat_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run customcat_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run customcat_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. customcat_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: customcat_list_products
tools.title: List your products
tools.description: List the products you set up in CustomCat (a design on one or more catalog items) with variants, SKUs, cost, price, stock flag and design images. Use the variant SKUs when placing an order for these products. GET /product.

since_id.description: Only products created after this product id.

updated_since.description: Only products created or updated since this date (as CustomCat expects, e.g. 2026-10-01).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: customcat_get_product
tools.title: Get one of your products
tools.description: One of your CustomCat products by id (e.g. 22-2580581): variants, SKUs, cost, price, options, designs. GET /product/{product_id}.

tools.name: customcat_list_designs
tools.title: List your designs
tools.description: List the designs uploaded to your CustomCat account: id, name, tags, image URLs, default product and last-updated time. GET /design.

since_id.description: Only designs created after this design id.

updated_since.description: Only designs created or updated since this date.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: customcat_list_catalog_categories
tools.title: List catalog categories
tools.description: The CustomCat catalog categories (Digisoft, Sublimation) and their subcategories (e.g. T-Shirts, Sweatshirts, Bags), to narrow customcat_list_catalog. GET /catalogcategory.

tools.name: customcat_list_catalog
tools.title: List the blank-product catalog
tools.description: Browse the full CustomCat catalog of printable blank products (the items you can order with your own artwork). Filter by category and subcategory from customcat_list_catalog_categories. The reply carries the total in `total`. GET /catalog.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: customcat_get_catalog_product
tools.title: Get a catalog product
tools.description: One catalog product by numeric id with its colors, sizes and SKUs. GET /catalog/{catalog_product_id}.

tools.name: customcat_get_catalog_sku
tools.title: Get a catalog SKU (stock check)
tools.description: One catalog SKU with its price and stock status. Use it before ordering: a SKU that is out of stock, discontinued or invalid makes the order fail. GET /catalog/sku/{catalog_sku_id}.

tools.name: customcat_list_shipping_methods
tools.title: List shipping methods
tools.description: The shipping methods CustomCat offers for a destination country (ids and names). The method name is required when placing an order. GET /shipping.

country_code.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. US, GB (default: United States).

tools.name: customcat_get_shipping_cost
tools.title: Get the shipping cost for items
tools.description: Calculate the shipping cost of one shipping method for a destination and a list of catalog SKUs with quantities. Read-only quote: it places nothing. POST /shipping/{shipping_id} (shipping_id from customcat_list_shipping_methods).

items.description: Catalog SKUs and quantities being shipped.

tools.name: customcat_get_order_status
tools.title: Get order status
tools.description: Status of an order by YOUR order id: order status (Pending, Verified, Shipped), per-item production status, shipments with tracking ids, totals and the ship-to address. Set sandbox=true to look up a sandbox test order. GET /order/status/{order_id}.

order_id.description: Your order id, exactly as sent when the order was placed.

tools.name: customcat_create_order
tools.title: Place an order
tools.description: WRITE: place an order for CustomCat to print and ship. This CHARGES the payment method on file in your CustomCat account (product cost + shipping; a front+back print adds $5 per line item) unless sandbox=true, which only validates the order. A real order (sandbox=false) also needs confirm=true, set only after the user confirmed it. The order id is yours and must be new (a duplicate is rejected). Needs the Write API key. Check stock with customcat_get_catalog_sku and the method name with customcat_list_shipping_methods first, and confirm the details with the user before calling. POST /order/{order_id}.

sandbox.description: true = test order, nothing is charged or produced; false = a real, paid order.

confirm.description: Required (true) for a real order (sandbox=false): set it only after the user has confirmed the items, address, shipping method and that their CustomCat payment method will be charged.

shipping_method.description: Method name from customcat_list_shipping_methods, e.g. Economy.

sku.description: SKU of a product made in CustomCat (from customcat_list_products, e.g. 22-115-4774-254). Use this OR catalog_sku + design_url.

catalog_sku.description: Catalog SKU (from customcat_list_catalog or customcat_get_catalog_sku) when you bring your own artwork.

design_url.description: Fully qualified https URL of the front design (needed with catalog_sku; leave out for a back-only print).

design_url_back.description: Optional https URL of the back design. A front+back print adds a $5 fee per line item.

mockup_url.description: Optional mockup of the front, used in QA.

mockup_url_back.description: Optional mockup of the back, used in QA.

preset_id.description: Optional design placement preset (2 full front, 3 full back, 4 default centre chest, 1 left chest wide, 10 left chest tall, 9 default back). Omit for exact artboard placement.

preset_back_id.description: Optional placement preset for the back design.

use_embedded_dpi.description: Use the DPI embedded in the image instead of the default 300.

line_item_id.description: Your own id for this line item.

items.description: Line items: either {sku, quantity} for products made in CustomCat, or {catalog_sku, design_url, quantity} for your own artwork.

tools.name: customcat_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel an order
tools.description: WRITE: cancel (delete) an order by YOUR order id. CustomCat can only cancel an order that has not gone into production; one already printed or shipped is refused. Needs the Write API key. Confirm with the user first. DELETE /order/{order_id}.

order_id.description: Your order id, exactly as sent when the order was placed.
